newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end up, further rises unlikely.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end up, further rises unlikely.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended higher on Thursday but failed to break above resistance at 20,500, suggesting that further rises could be limited.
"The pick-up in the cash index led the recovery. And some stops were triggered on the way up around 20,350-20,400," said a dealer with an Asian futures house.
After hitting a high of 20,500, the benchmark Nikkei 225 September contract finished at 20,405 against a previous settlement at 20,195.
In Tokyo, the 225-share Nikkei average closed up 177.95 points at 20,379.82.
Dealers said the market had made a healthy correction after being dragged down by news of the U.S. missile attacks on Iraq on Tuesday and Wednesday.
"We should come off to around 20,300 tomorrow. There was good resistance at 20,500," said the trader, adding that further gains would be restricted to 20,650 at most.
